TIMEOUT_MS.title: Request timeout (ms)
TIMEOUT_MS.description: How long a single request may take before it is aborted.

MAX_BODY_BYTES.title: Max response body (bytes)
MAX_BODY_BYTES.description: Response bodies are streamed and truncated past this cap so a large response cannot exhaust memory.

ALLOW_PRIVATE_NETWORK.title: Allow private/internal hosts
ALLOW_PRIVATE_NETWORK.description: Off by default: requests to loopback, private, and link-local addresses are refused. Turn on only to call a service on your own machine or LAN.
